title: Finite etale algebra of a root of a unit
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n\geq1$ an integer whose image in $R$ is a unit, and $u\in R^\times$. Set $B=R[T]/(T^n-u)$, with its canonical $R$-algebra structure, using the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring] and quotient algebra [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Then $B$ is free as an $R$-module with basis $1,t,\ldots,t^{n-1}$, where $t$ is the class of $T$, and the canonical morphism $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is finite, surjective and etale [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. The zero ring and $n=1$ are allowed.

source.place: Tag 03PL, lemma-kummer-sequence, proof: the explicit unit-root algebra A[T]/(T^n-a) is finite free of rank n, surjective, and standard etale because nT^{n-1} is invertible.

proof.text: Put f=X^n-C(u). Since n>=1, f is monic. If R is nontrivial, its natural degree is n, so the Mathlib power basis AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' of [lem-weil-pbc-monic-quotient-free], reindexed along natDegree f=n, is the requested Fin n-indexed basis with b_i=t^i. If R is the zero ring, the quotient is a singleton module and Module.Basis.uniqueBasis gives the basis on the same index type; all its values equal t^i.

proof.text: The monic quotient is a finite module by Polynomial.Monic.finite_adjoinRoot, the finiteness clause of [lem-weil-pbc-monic-quotient-free]. Translate this through RingHom.finite_algebraMap and [lem-weil-pbc-spec-finite-ring-map-finite] to obtain the finite spectrum morphism.

source.place: Tag 03PL, lemma-kummer-sequence, proof: the explicit unit-root algebra A[T]/(T^n-a) is finite free of rank n, surjective, and standard etale because nT^{n-1} is invertible.

proof.text: The polynomial has nonzero degree: it has degree n over a nontrivial ring, while over the zero ring its degree is bottom, which is also different from zero. Apply the proved source helper AdjoinRoot.faithfullyFlat_of_monic (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.RingTheory.Flat.FaithfullyFlat.Basic). This is the finite-free argument from [lem-weil-pbc-monic-quotient-free]: a nonempty basis makes the quotient nontrivial over a nontrivial base, hence its free-module flatness is faithful; over a zero base the maximal-ideal condition is vacuous. RingHom.faithfullyFlat_algebraMap_iff and flat_and_surjective_SpecMap_iff give surjectivity, implementing [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-surjective-spectrum] and [def-weil-surjective-morphism].

source.place: Tag 03PL, lemma-kummer-sequence, proof: the explicit unit-root algebra A[T]/(T^n-a) is finite free of rank n, surjective, and standard etale because nT^{n-1} is invertible.

proof.text: Apply the already proved source specialization AdjoinRoot.etale_X_pow_sub_C with n!=0, the given IsUnit(n:R), and u.isUnit. This helper is audited as closed under [lem-sc-kummer-exact] and proves Algebra.Etale R (AdjoinRoot f), including the zero ring and n=1, using the standard-etale pair (f,1) and its derivative certificate. RingHom.etale_algebraMap and HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P:=Etale) give [def-weil-etale-morphism] for the canonical spectrum map. Conjoin this with the basis, finiteness and surjectivity already proved.

lean.statement: theorem unitBinomial_finite_surjective_etale (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnR : IsUnit (n : R)) (u : Rˣ) : (∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R (AdjoinRoot (Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C (u : R))), ∀ i : Fin n, b i = AdjoinRoot.root (Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C (u : R)) ^ (i : ℕ)) ∧ IsFinite (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (AdjoinRoot (Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C (u : R)))))) ∧ Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (AdjoinRoot (Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C (u : R)))))) ∧ Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (AdjoinRoot (Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C (u : R))))))
